Ricochet Rage

Ricochet Rage

About Ricochet Rage

Launch your stickman, bounce off the walls and smash every enemy in one shot! Ricochet Rage is a physics action game where every launch is a trick shot. Chain ricochets into big combos, unleash Rage mode and pick a new upgrade after every wave. Fight through 20 levels, beat 4 epic bosses and unlock gear, pets and skins. Modes: Story, Daily, Weekly Gauntlet, Endless and Boss Rush.

How to play

Mouse Touch Drag back from the hero to aim release to launch Tap the power-up buttons bottom right or press 1 2 3 to use power-ups Space retry after game over P Esc pause
